title.zh: 晚高峰国际骨干网抖动自查：如何判断是本地宽带QoS还是节点故障？
title.en: Peak Congestion Diagnostic: Differentiating Local ISP QoS from Server Outages

description.zh: 网络卡顿时别急着怪机场！教你使用 mtr、ping 及 Speedtest 快速定位是电信/移动骨干网限速还是节点服务器出现故障。
description.en: A practical networking diagnostic guide using MTR, ping, and path tracing to determine if slowdowns stem from local ISP QoS or upstream servers.
